property_summary: For every call to transfer(...) with any non-empty _tos and any callee address, the reference C never reverts when the callee call succeeds (i.e. if the external call returns true then transfer completes); the mutant inverts that check and will revert when the callee call succeeds, so there exist inputs (a callee that returns success) that make the mutant revert while the reference does not.
change_summary: Invert the require on the call result so call success causes revert and failure allows continuing, changing observable revert behavior.
